title: Jeopard
summary: JEOPARD, verb transitive jep'ard. [See Jeopardy.] To hazard; to put in danger; to expose to loss or injury. Zebulon and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives to the death in the high place

inlines.v: JEOPARD, verb transitive jep'ard. [See Jeopardy.] To hazard; to put in danger; to expose to loss or injury. Zebulon and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives to the death in the high places of the field. Judges 5:18.
